name: holmes
description: Desktop AI harness for non-coding AI usage. Connect to OpenRouter and more.
author: Wiles Creative

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:electron && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: pnpm test:call-history && pnpm test:remote && pnpm test:credit-breaker && pnpm test:play && pnpm test:psychology && pnpm test:product-search && pnpm test:recall && pnpm test:recall-history && pnpm test:memory && pnpm test:activity-accounts && pnpm test:health && pnpm test:document-context && pnpm test:context-search && pnpm test:timeline && pnpm test:roles && pnpm test:library && pnpm test:people && pnpm test:work && pnpm test:design && pnpm test:generation-intent && pnpm test:context-stack && pnpm test:token-estimate && pnpm test:chat-branching && pnpm test:citations
scripts.build:sidecar: cd healthkit-sidecar && mkdir -p .build/release && (swift build -c release 2>/dev/null || swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macosx13 -sdk /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk -framework HealthKit -framework Foundation Sources/main.swift -o .build/release/healthkit-sidecar) && rm -rf ../node_modules/.holmes/healthkit-sidecar.app && mkdir -p ../node_modules/.holmes/healthkit-sidecar.app/Contents/MacOS ../node_modules/.holmes/healthkit-sidecar.app/Contents/Resources && cp .build/release/healthkit-sidecar ../node_modules/.holmes/healthkit-sidecar.app/Contents/MacOS/healthkit-sidecar && cp Info.plist ../node_modules/.holmes/healthkit-sidecar.app/Contents/Info.plist && find ../node_modules/.holmes/healthkit-sidecar.app -name '._*' -delete && xattr -cr ../node_modules/.holmes/healthkit-sidecar.app && codesign --force -s - ../node_modules/.holmes/healthkit-sidecar.app
scripts.build:sidecar:holmes: cd holmes-sidecar && mkdir -p .build/release && (swift build -c release 2>/dev/null || swiftc -O -parse-as-library -target arm64-apple-macosx13 -sdk /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX14.5.sdk -framework Foundation -framework CoreLocation -framework Photos -framework HealthKit Sources/main.swift -o .build/release/holmes-sidecar) && rm -rf ../node_modules/.holmes/holmes-sidecar.app && mkdir -p ../node_modules/.holmes/holmes-sidecar.app/Contents/MacOS ../node_modules/.holmes/holmes-sidecar.app/Contents/Resources && cp .build/release/holmes-sidecar ../node_modules/.holmes/holmes-sidecar.app/Contents/MacOS/holmes-sidecar && cp Info.plist ../node_modules/.holmes/holmes-sidecar.app/Contents/Info.plist && codesign --entitlements entitlements.plist --force -s - ../node_modules/.holmes/holmes-sidecar.app
